Author: Stwohm (fork of yagi2/Restocker)
Name: Restocky
Punchline: Restocker fork: bulk reprice with price guards, history log and an optional bell auto-cycle.
Description: Personal fork of yagi2/Restocker. Cross-retainer market workbench: reprice every listing to the live market lowest -N gil, bulk-list inventory with stack splitting. Fork additions: fixes for the duplicate-listing queue crash and stale-snapshot row mismatch, price guards (per-item floor, max drop %, outlier skip), a persistent price-history.csv, a one-click full cycle and an optional timed auto-cycle while at the summoning bell.
Changelog: 0.3.17.2 — Retainer board readability: colour-coded text instead of cell backgrounds, with a legend (green Filled, grey Reserved, red Blocking, orange price = undercut, amber age = stuck, grey ! = stale, blue Hold). Fixed columns, right-aligned prices, cards wrap to the window. Stock tracking marks board-planned Restock to values with 'board' and explains where they come from. QA fixes: pinned board positions stay stable, Fill to plan prefers a full lot, crystal withdraw respects Keep room, bulk listing no longer reuses slots from earlier rows, renamed retainers show the current name.
